_readme: Seed for unit_definitions and unit_conversions. RULE: no conversion row ships without a real, citable source (the seed script refuses rows with an empty source). `conversions` is intentionally empty until sourced values are added. Each conversion is { food_group | ingredient_ref:{source,source_id}, state: raw|cooked|any, unit, grams_per_unit  OR  density_g_per_ml (no unit), basis, source, note }.

unit_definitions.source: Project owner: medium katori is about 200-250 ml; midpoint used
unit_definitions.note: Katori sizes vary by household. One constant, change it here and re-seed. A commercial blog cites 150 ml as 'standard' with no authoritative source; the owner's 200-250 ml was used instead.
